steps.label: the app is up, with a 4 × 3 m room and nothing in it
F1 — the four tools stand, and the wall editor is gone
F1 — + Box is on screen in a ONE-WALL job (it was NOT)
F1 — …and the box reaches the room
F1 — a cabinet STOPS at the breast (2600) rather than driving through it
F1 — …and stands IN the alcove, which is why one is drawn
a run of five, and one parked clear of it — nothing offered
F2 — DRIVING a cabinet up to the run FIRES the share-out (T50 asked on the ADD only)
F2 — a RESIZE fires it too
F2 — …and a colour/hinge change does NOT pay for it
F2 — the run is laid out to the wall, and every cabinet MOVED
F2 — no cabinet overlaps another — the rule that is absolute
F2 — and NOT ONE "limited by" notice: the fillers stood down
F3 — parked apart, there is no panel
F3 — *dojeżdżam* — the panel APPEARS
F3 — *nie dojeżdżam* — it VANISHES, rather than being left behind
F3 — removed by hand, it STAYS gone while that junction lasts
F3 — …but away and back is a NEW junction, so it may return
F6 — the panel is a ROOM: ceiling, left wall, right wall, facing
F6 — each lamp has an ON/OFF and a strength
F6 — the four presets are offered
F6 — and the panel SAYS the export ignores it
steps.detail: Renders and PDFs ignore these switches — they always use one

steps.label: F6 — the EDITOR changes when a lamp is switched
F6 — THE EXPORT IGNORES THE PANEL: the export rig is IDENTICAL, lamp for lamp
F7 — Database ▸ Materials opens the WAREHOUSE, with nine departments and Others
F7 — it says it is offline and keeps working
F7 — a row TYPED reaches the warehouse, numbered automatically
F7 — …and the record says the price was TYPED
F7 — a JC import matched on jc_uuid OVERWROTE, never duplicated
F7 — …keeping the shelf label (item_number 0001)
F7 — …and the hand-typed price change is REPORTED, not silent
F7 — TWO exports, named as CLAUDE.md writes them
